Welcome to AFRICAN SAFARI LODGE
Welcome to African Safari Lodge, your gateway to an unforgettable adventure in the heart of the Eastern Cape!
Nestled just 17km outside of Grahamstown, and conveniently located a scenic one and a half-hour drive from Port Elizabeth, our Lodge awaits to whisk you away to paradise.
Perched majestically on a serene ridge overlooking the picturesque upper Kariega , our Lodge, Luxury Suite, and Deluxe River Suites offer unrivaled views of nature's splendor. Whether you choose self-catering, bed and breakfast, or fully catered accommodation every moment promises luxury and comfort, carefully curated to exceed your expectations.
Step onto our spacious patios complete with braai facilities and immerse yourself in the tranquil ambiance as you soak in the sights and sights of the river and valley below. Here, amidst natures embrace, every day unfolds with endless possibilities for adventure and relaxation.
Embark on exhilarating game drives, traverse rugged landscapes on bush walks, or glide along the gentle currents on river boat cruises. Cast your line into the pristine waters for thrilling fishing expedition, or simply unwind at lookout points, marveling at the majestic presence of zebras, buffalos, and a diverse array of wildlife.
At African Safari Lodge, every moment is a testament to the beauty of nature and the joy of exploration. Join us and discover your own piece of paradise in the heart of the Eastern Cape.

The Lodge African Safari Lodge
Skip to main content
THE LODGE
Book Now
THE LOdge Location
African Safari Lodge is situated on a private game reserve 17km outside of Grahamstown. The lodge is perched 20 meters above the high water mark on the Settlers dam with breath-taking views up river. Animal and bird sightings along the river banks are a guaranteed occurrence from the spacious viewing porches. The Lodge borders the Thomas Baines Nature Reserve, situated in the main water catchment area of Grahamstown at the confluence of two rivers – the dominant Kariega River flowing 40km further to meet the Indian Ocean at Kenton-on-Sea.
Malaria-free, the area is known as Frontier Country embracing a variety of cultures, from existing tribes and others establishing themselves as early as 1812. Perfectly balanced, African Safari Lodge is a nature lover’s paradise with dense ravine thickets, scattered thorn trees and open areas making this an idyllic outdoor experience.
Our PHILOSOPHY
The African Safari Lodge philosophy is driven by making quality and lasting friendships, bringing guests closer to nature and ensuring that they experience enduring memories. The lodge can be booked in its entirety or per person/per room depending on the need. The lodge sleeps 6-9 people, and is made up of three bedrooms en-suite on the ground floor, a three bed attic, a large double volume lounge, dining room and a bar is available with a separate kitchen.
Two Deluxe River Suites are perched on the river bank with similar views as the main lodge. The Deluxe River Suites can accommodate two adults each in a King or twin bed setup as well as two small children. Both units have spacious patio’s with built in braai facilities as well as fully equipped compact kitchen and en-suite bathrooms.

Luxury Suite African Safari Lodge
Skip to main content
LUXURY
SUITE
Book Now
This luxuriously appointed and perfectly positioned freestanding suite is our newest addition and offers a spacious room with a King size bed, and includes your own private compact kitchenette with private patio and braai facilities.
Décor is elegant, fresh, and contemporary while maintaining earthy elements. The ensuite bathroom boasts a freestanding bath, vanity and separate large walk-in shower.
The Luxury Suite is nestled amongst the thick brush on a low ridge in the most beautiful location along the upper Kariega at the crown of two rivers, with breath-taking views.
Within walking distance from the lodge, the luxury suite provides a view within a view of the valley floor.  The river below attracts wildlife while enjoying sundowners from your private viewing patio.
It captures the spirit of nature and luxury in one unique experience.

DELUXE SUITES

The Deluxe River Suites are perched on a low ridge in the most beautiful location along the upper Kariega at the crown of two rivers, with breathtaking views.
L ocated side by side and a walk away from the lodge they provide a wide and unobstructed view of the valley floor, and the river below attracts wildlife while enjoying sundowners from your private viewing patio. The Suites are of generous size and space, with a King size bed, and included your own private kitchenette and braai facilities.
It captures the spirit of nature and luxury in one unique experience.
